decisions.reason: The premium sharing salami line is cheap to maintain on established processes, but after two years without visible new support its option value is shrinking, so it stays under watch rather than being dropped now.
The organic Fleischwurst was launched only in 2024 and fits the firm's strategic organic expansion, so its uncertainty is unresolved and keeping it costs little.
The organic thin-sliced chicken breast line is a recent extension into a growing format, and one year of evidence is too little to judge its value, so the option is kept open.
The organic herb-coated salami is new and cheap to produce, but organic salami variants have already been pruned once, so it is kept while being watched closely.
